title: should render v5 parts conversation in the Preview pane (reasoning / tool_call / tool_call_response)
verifies: the Input pane renders reasoning + tool_call text and the Output pane renders tool_call_response text, with no raw '"type":"tool_call"' JSON dump

title: should render System Instructions via v5 parts as a collapsible
verifies: gen_ai.system.instructions renders a 'System Instructions' collapsible above the Input pane whose expanded body shows the extracted text

title: should render thinking / result real-world aliases
verifies: the real-world SDK aliases type:'thinking' (reasoning) and tool_call_response.result (response) both render as text

title: should render execute_tool span as a tool-observation view
verifies: an execute_tool span renders the .tool-content view with 'Tool: calculator' and 'Call ID: call-123'

title: should render blob / file / uri parts as placeholders (never base64)
verifies: blob/file/uri parts each render their own placeholder ('[image: image/png]', '[File: file-abc123]', '[Uri: …]') and the raw base64 payloads are never exposed

title: should truncate long content with an expand/collapse button
verifies: content over 15 lines truncates with an expand button; expanding reveals full content and collapsing returns to the truncated preview

title: should render v5 parts in the Thread tab
verifies: the Thread tab transcript renders the extracted v5 parts message text, mirroring the Preview pane
